comment: F-1 Round 25 — recovery bridge end-to-end vectors. Spec authority: services/coauth-recovery.md + services/soland-recovery-ticket.md + services/restore-executor.md. Recovery flow: (1) coauth principal-cache lookup proves account → principal_did + verified DIDs; (2) coauth issues recovery_action_proof with risk_action_kind=recover_session_grants; (3) soland mints a recovery_ticket bound to the action_proof + the target space + an idempotency_key; (4) restore_executor consumes the ticket, replays the chosen artifact (key_backup blob restore + session-grant re-issue), emits final state Move; (5) the artifact's state is observable on the destination space via standard reducer. End-to-end vectors stitch each step together.

vectors.name: principal_cache_resolves_account_did_to_principal_space
vectors.comment: Step 1: coauth resolves did:web:alice.example to her principal_space_id and verified DID set. This is the authoritative claim chain origin.

expected.rationale: Principal-space lookup is byte-deterministic per coauth DidResolverService; cotest cross-checks against soland's parity-tested derivation.

vectors.name: recovery_action_proof_minted_for_high_risk
vectors.comment: Step 2: coauth mints a recovery_action_proof for risk_action_kind=recover_session_grants. With high_risk_threshold=2, the proposal needs 2 admin approvals; once accumulated, coauth signs and emits a JWS proof binding (action_kind, account_did, idempotency_key, nbf, exp, approvers[]).

expected.rationale: Quorum-met high-risk action mints a JWS proof; soland will verify this proof before minting a ticket.

vectors.name: soland_mints_recovery_ticket_against_proof
vectors.comment: Step 3: soland verifies the coauth recovery_action_proof JWS, scopes it to the destination space, mints a recovery_ticket with a fresh ticket_id + ttl=1800. The ticket is consumed-once (idempotency_key dedup).

expected.rationale: Soland mints a single-use ticket; idempotency_key dedup prevents double-mint on retry.

vectors.name: restore_executor_consumes_ticket_and_replays_artifact
vectors.comment: Step 4: restore_executor pulls the ticket, fetches the target key_backup blob (using the user's recovery passphrase delivered out-of-band), decrypts session keys, re-issues session grants in the destination space, emits final state Move (cx.recovery.session_grants_restored.v1). Ticket transitions issued→executing→executed.

expected.rationale: Atomic restore: blob decrypt + grants re-issue + final-state Move all succeed or all fail; ticket lifecycle reflects exactly one execution.

vectors.name: final_state_observable_via_reducer
vectors.comment: Step 5: After execute, the standard reducer projects the recovery effects: session-grants cell shows the re-issued grants, key-backup cell shows the latest restored version_id. Cotest fetches /api/v1/spaces/<id>/cells/cx.component.session_grant.v1 and confirms the cell content.

expected.rationale: Reducer is the authoritative projection; final state is observable to all permitted readers via standard cell-fetch.

negative_vectors.name: expired_proof_rejected_by_soland
negative_vectors.comment: Coauth proof's exp claim is in the past; soland MUST reject ticket-mint with reason recovery_proof_expired.

expected.rationale: Time-bound proof: soland verifies nbf <= now <= exp before minting a ticket.

negative_vectors.name: double_consume_ticket_rejected
negative_vectors.comment: Restore executor tries to consume an already-executed ticket. Idempotency: the second call MUST return the prior result without re-executing (consume_once + idempotent_response).

expected.rationale: Already-consumed ticket returns the prior response (consume_once invariant); never double-applies side effects.
